rv.q: This is a fine effort by a talented cast but I see the direction and the interpretation of Sibblies Drury’s writing as the issue here.
Everyone should be given a fair view of this excellent production for themselves.
Definition Theatre has launched an incisive, suitably atonal but pitch-perfect Chicago premiere of Jackie Sibblies Drury’s 2019. Pulitzer Prize-winning play, "Fairview."

The extraordinary excellence ending, where Jada Jackson, playing Keisha, brings the white audience into an emotional performance, articulating the importance of listening to Blacks speaking their stories, saves this production.

cn.t: Critics praise this Pulitzer winner's bold twists and gut-punch social commentary, with Definition Theatre's incisive production expertly navigating the play's challenging shift from realism to absurdism.
